summary: MZ73 retry job 1344 completed the exact eight-structure MatRIS/AQCat25 fixed prediction batch after passing a physical-GPU free-memory gate; work-side review verified all structure/checkpoint hashes and complete finite 50x3 force arrays.

payload.objective: Obtain VASP force labels on the same eight reviewed seed/fail structures so MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors can distinguish model error from path/geometry failure.
current_evidence: The user separately authorized one retry of the unchanged eight-structure GPU prediction request.
The retry bound physical GPU UUID GPU-483c224e-cc19-13e2-24ad-c83efd14fa75 and required at least 14000 MiB free at runtime; the preflight observed 15987 MiB free.
Slurm job 1344 completed on MZ73 with ExitCode 0:0 in 14 seconds, and the producer exit record reports success.
The returned set contains exactly eight unique requested structure hashes and the frozen MatRIS and AQCat25 checkpoint hashes.
Both models returned finite energies and complete 50x3 all-atom force arrays for every structure.
The largest movable-force model-model disagreement is seed_13 with vector RMSE 0.19768059002625307 eV/A and vector maximum 0.7031833832264708 eV/A.
Model-model disagreement is a VASP-label sampling score only; it is not calibrated uncertainty, a DFT result, or a TS/path validity decision.
No VASP label, model fine-tuning, ML-NEB rerun, Dimer, TS, or barrier action was submitted.
payload.one_executable_step: After separate explicit user authorization, submit the already prepared hash-bound eight-structure SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP NSW=0 static-force label batch; do not fine-tune or rerun the path in the same action.
payload.submission_boundary: GPU job 1344 is complete. VASP labels, model fine-tuning, path rerun, micro-NEB, Dimer, TS, and barrier actions remain unauthorized.
done_when: All eight matching VASP static-force labels finish with scheduler, normal-termination, electronic-convergence, complete-force, magnetic, structure-hash, and DFT-fingerprint evidence.
MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors are reviewed and a separate fine-tuning or path-method decision is recorded.
